Kind Note – – – – – Table 11.23: UserDefinedServiceInstanceToMachineMapping Rationale for [constr_1570]: for a local IPC binding it is sometimes necessary to define properties of the IPC system. And for this purpose the UserDefinedCommunicationConnector mapped to an AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance can be used to define global properties (e.g. for service discovery) of a given "IPC-Domain". In other words, each defined UserDefinedCommunicationConnector may represent such an "IPC-Domain" that requires a dedicated configuration on the basis of the definition of Sdgs.
